-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem removeCfg_learnersNext (id : w64) (c : CfgM) (k : w64) : k ∈ (removeCfg id c).learnersNext ↔
    k ≠ id ∧ k ∈ c.learnersNext

theorem CCGood.applyM {s s' : CCState} (h : CCGood s) (ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM) (H : applyM ccs
    s = some s') : CCGood s'

theorem cfgStateC_simple (cfg lrn : GSet w64) : cfgStateC (CfgM.simple cfg lrn) = cfgState cfg lrn

theorem CCGood.applyOne {s s' : CCState} (h : CCGood s) (cc : ConfChangeSingleM) (H : applyOne cc s
    = some s') : CCGood s'

def CCGood (s : CCState) : Prop :=
  (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ s.prs ↔ k ∈ s.cfg.ids) ∧
    (∀ (k : w64) (b : Bool), s.prs !! k = some b → b = decide (k ∈ s.cfg.learners)) ∧
      (∀ (k : w64), k ∈ s.cfg.learners → ¬k ∈ s.cfg.incoming ∧ ¬k ∈ s.cfg.outgoing) ∧
        ∀ (k : w64), k ∈ s.cfg.learnersNext → k ∈ s.cfg.outgoing

theorem CCGood.remove {s : CCState} (h : CCGood s) (id : w64) : CCGood (removeM id s)

theorem CCGood.leaveJoint {s s' : CCState} (h : CCGood s) (H : leaveJointM s = some s') : CCGood s'

theorem mem_ids (c : CfgM) (k : w64) : k ∈ c.ids ↔ k ∈ c.incoming ∨ k ∈ c.outgoing ∨ k ∈ c.learners

theorem CCGood.clearAutoLeave {s : CCState} (h : CCGood s) : CCGood (clearAutoLeave s)

theorem gm_lookup_delete {V : Type} (m : GMap w64 V) (i k : w64) : GMap.delete i m !! k = if k = i
    then none else m !! k

theorem CCGood.applyAll {s s' : CCState} (h : CCGood s) (ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM) (H : applyAll
    ccs s = some s') : CCGood s'

theorem CCGood.initProgress {s : CCState} (h : CCGood s) (id : w64) (lrn : Bool) (hn : ¬id ∈ s.prs)
    : CCGood (initProgressM id lrn s)

theorem removeCfg_incoming (id : w64) (c : CfgM) (k : w64) : k ∈ (removeCfg id c).incoming ↔ k ≠ id
    ∧ k ∈ c.incoming

theorem CCGood.enterJoint {s s' : CCState} (h : CCGood s) (al : Bool) (ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM)
    (H : enterJointM al ccs s = some s') : CCGood s'

theorem gm_mem_delete {V : Type} (m : GMap w64 V) (i k : w64) : k ∈ GMap.delete i m ↔ k ≠ i ∧ k ∈ m

theorem CCGood.flags {c : CfgM} {f : GMap w64 Bool} (h : CCGood { cfg := c, prs := f }) : f =
    cfgFlags c.voters c.learners

theorem CCGood.makeVoter {s : CCState} (h : CCGood s) (id : w64) : CCGood (makeVoterM id s)

theorem ccApplyM_inv {s s' : CCState} (t : raftpb.ConfChangeTransition) (ccs : List
    ConfChangeSingleM) (H : ccApplyM t ccs s = some s') : CfgInv s'

theorem removeCfg_learners (id : w64) (c : CfgM) (k : w64) : k ∈ (removeCfg id c).learners ↔ k ≠ id
    ∧ k ∈ c.learners

theorem gm_lookup_insert {V : Type} (m : GMap w64 V) (i k : w64) (v : V) : <[i := v]>m !! k = if k =
    i then some v else m !! k

theorem CCGood.simple {s s' : CCState} (h : CCGood s) (ccs : List ConfChangeSingleM) (H : simpleM
    ccs s = some s') : CCGood s'

theorem removeCfg_outgoing (id : w64) (c : CfgM) : (removeCfg id c).outgoing = c.outgoing

theorem ccApplyM_good {s s' : CCState} (h : CCGood s) (t : raftpb.ConfChangeTransition) (ccs : List
    ConfChangeSingleM) (H : ccApplyM t ccs s = some s') : CCGood s'

theorem CCGood.makeLearner {s : CCState} (h : CCGood s) (id : w64) : CCGood (makeLearnerM id s)

theorem gm_mem_insert {V : Type} (m : GMap w64 V) (i k : w64) (v : V) : k ∈ <[i := v]>m ↔ k = i ∨ k
    ∈ m

theorem ccGood_cfgState (V : GSet w64) : CCGood (cfgState V ∅)

def cfgStateC (c : CfgM) : CCState :=
  { cfg := c, prs := cfgFlags c.voters c.learners }
